comparison.objective: Infer and hand-write a winning tic-tac-toe mark, then return the marker; not tune machinery.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual reasoning, spring-nib contact control, glyph writing, and tool hanging versus recessed-tool use, fine rotation, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Correct glyph and cell, no stray ink, marker rehung and released versus two safe repeatable carriage stops with no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Tool use and controlled force are generic commonalities; the tested abilities and outputs differ. No separate specs were present.
